behavior: Manifest Main-Class is com.example.Main. Bundled Gson/OkHttp/JNA libraries do not explain the first-party credential collection. No normal application workflow or authorized migration context is supplied.

Offline Dec.s reconstruction decoded 784 strings from the 24-bit-length-indexed vault with its LCG64 keystream. Main resolves an HTTPS server through an Ethereum eth_call result and posts account context, collected JSON, individual files and logs to receive endpoints.

javap confirms ensureJnaReady -> bypassKeyRestriction -> downloadDriver/store Main.driver -> system/Discord/browser/file acquisition. JADX misleadingly reordered nested try blocks, so bytecode determines initialization order.

PasswordHandler copies browser login stores, reads JDBC login columns and decrypts password bytes. FirefoxHandler parses saved logins and calls NSS PK11SDR_Decrypt, and also queries copied cookies.sqlite. DiscordHandler scans LevelDB for plaintext/encrypted tokens, decrypts protected tokens and validates them against users/@me.

BrowserHelper supplies app-bound encrypted keys to DllInjectionHelper, which launches a suspended browser, allocates/writes remote memory, maps a generated PE payload, starts a remote thread and receives decrypted key bytes over a named pipe.

FileHandler collects wallet stores and Minecraft/Roblox/Steam authentication material. Main wraps file bytes in multipart POST bodies. This unrelated multi-application secret collection plus remote upload and application replacement tips the judgment over legitimate password recovery.

WHandler fetches replacement bytes and writes Exodus resources/app.asar and Discord desktop-core index.js. PythonInstaller fetches follow-on source and writes it to a process running python -c import sys;exec(sys.stdin.read()). No final payload needs to be known to establish these capabilities.

Guard checks hashes of bundled resources. The VM class implements a reflective interpreter and resource decryptor, but vm.bin is absent; its presence is not evidence that virtualized code ran. The active application string vault is Dec/strings.bin.
StagingHelper and an embedded RSA signing key/helper exist, but were not promoted to active persistence or signing on the inspected Main path.

remaining_rule_gaps: Custom encrypted string-vault contents are not exposed by stock cleave facts. Direct wallet/game-token collection, Discord/Exodus replacement, JCE restriction changes, blockchain endpoint resolution and downloaded Python execution therefore lack complete direct YAML detections in this artifact. Existing composites cover the supported browser-collection/upload/concealment roles. No brittle per-artifact names, keys or ciphertext signatures were added.

The full-archive classifier agrees with both verdicts. PasswordHandler and FirefoxHandler retain very low individual ML scores despite their credential-collection behavior; archive context establishes their malicious role. CryptoHelper and VM are reusable capabilities and should not independently be forced into a malicious classification.
